title: The first rational Tate twist has local bases after pullback
statement: Let l be a prime, X a scheme with l invertible in Gamma(X,O_X), and f:Y->X arbitrary. Let B_X=p_X^*padicAlgClRingObj(l) and let L_X=tateTwistOne X l be the scalar extension of the actual integral inverse-limit module [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. There is a pro-etale covering (u_i:V_i->Y) on which mapMod(u_i^*) mapMod(f^*) L_X is isomorphic to the regular module over u_i^*f^*B_X [def-sfb-finite-upper-star].

source.place: Scalar extension of the integral Tate line and the assertion that the first coefficient twist is a locally free line.

proof.text: Take the local bases of the integral Tate module supplied by [lem-poincare-integral-tate-pullback-local-line]. For the monoidal adjunction f^* adjoint f_*, naturality of the unit makes restriction of scalars commute with the lifted direct image. Conjugating that square gives f^* mapMod followed by extension along f^*a isomorphic to extension along a followed by f^* mapMod. This is implemented by pullIsoOfComapIso and comapMapModComapIso. Apply it for f and for each covering morphism.

Extension of scalars sends a free R-module on an object to the free S-module on that same object: both composites are left adjoint to the same forgetful functor. At the tensor unit this gives Ext_a(regular R) isomorphic to regular S, using the right unitor. Map each integral local basis through extension of scalars and compose the two preceding pullback comparisons. By [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], the original extension is exactly tateTwistOne, not a rationalized surrogate.

theorem tateTwistOne_pullback_locally_trivial
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage Y, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty
        ((((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝒰.f i)).mapMod
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X))).obj
          (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).mapMod
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) X)).obj
              (tateTwistOne X ℓ))) ≅ 𝟙_ _)
